items.title: 6.6.1 Evolving Technologies in Cloud Computing (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of evolving cloud technologies (PDF 168).

blocks.text: Nayi technologies cloud computing ko zyada kaarkard, qabil-e-tausee aur aasan rasai wala bana rahi hain; do aham edge computing aur serverless architectures hain.

blocks.prompt: Agle kaunsi do cloud technologies batayi gayi hain?

items: Badalti cloud: edge computing aur serverless.
